password.title: Change password
password.desc: Use at least 10 characters with 2 kinds, or at least 8 characters with 3 kinds, of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and symbols. Your ID and common passwords are not allowed.
password.mismatch: The new password and confirmation do not match.
password.success: Your password has been changed. Sessions signed in elsewhere are signed out.
password.error: Could not change the password. Please try again later.
password.PASSWORD_SAME_AS_CURRENT: Enter a password different from the current one.
password.PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK: Use at least 10 characters with 2 kinds, or at least 8 characters with 3 kinds, of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and symbols.
password.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: The new password is too long. Use up to 72 bytes (about 72 letters, or 24 Korean characters).
password.PASSWORD_COMMON: This password is too common and easy to guess. Choose another.
password.PASSWORD_CONTAINS_LOGIN_ID: The password cannot contain your ID.
